text: We evaluated an evolution-strategy refinement method that uses swap-consistency as its fitness signal, with an ES population of 16, transferring supervision from a gpt2-large weak model to a mistral-7b strong model. Across num_seeds = 2 seeds, the method reached a transfer accuracy of 0.68 (SE 0.04) and a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.44 with a standard error of 0.17, against reference points of 0.58 weak-model accuracy and 0.81 strong-model ceiling accuracy. The baseline PGR is 0.51, which sits above the measured PGR, so this run provides no evidence of a gain from the ES refinement; with only two seeds and a PGR standard error of 0.17, the comparison is also well within the noise either way. These numbers should be read as preliminary: the seed count is too small to characterize run-to-run variability, and the ordering relative to baseline could plausibly reverse with additional seeds.
